scope: Supporting inspection of existing SVG source; not an Arena verdict or final-article validation.
method: Read-only PowerShell and .NET XML parsing with external XML resolution disabled; source geometry, text nodes, counts and SHA-256 inspected.
modifications: Only this supporting JSON report was created.

stacked_bars.evidence: Eight clipped segment paths, patch_3 through patch_10, occupy three distinct horizontal bands: y=201.486281, 135.578589 and 69.670897. Text labels: Scored cases, Selected cases, Design cells.

eleven_case_segment.evidence: Grey patch_6 is adjacent to the 405 scored segment. Its width ratio to patch_5 times 405 equals 11 to six decimals. Section E identifies it as unscored.

eleven_numeric_label.evidence: All 12 text elements were read. None labels the grey segment with 11. The caption must supply the count.

disposition_conflicts.evidence: The three bars encode scored outcomes, selected status and omissions. No separate segment or label describes the nine conflicting dispositions.

figures.caption_limits: The source title uses design cells for 496; this label does not define a technical unit. Retain the eleven-case caption count and the selected/scored distinction.

interval_label.exact_text: Pass fraction among scored cases (dot); 95% Wilson interval (bar)

environment_intervals.evidence: Direct clipped interval paths under axes_1, grouped by red, amber and green stroke, excluding the one dashed pooled reference path.

wilson_endpoint_spot_checks.method: Mapped SVG endpoint coordinates onto axis ticks 0 and 1; compared with Wilson formula using z=1.959963984540054.
wilson_endpoint_spot_checks.limit: Two distinct endpoint calculations checked; not a recomputation of every interval.

figures.caption_limits: Use a binomial sampling convention with selection and possible dependence qualifications. These intervals do not measure seed variation. Two entirely unscored environments are outside the 36 plotted environments.

data_glyphs.evidence: Clipped patch paths directly under axes_1, excluding axes/background and legend patches. Source title: Each square is one environment x difficulty-tuple row (340 rows). Paths are rectangular cell glyphs.

unscored_glyphs.evidence: 11 data paths use fill #9e9e9e; the legend identifies grey as unscored.

multicase_numbers.evidence: 44 direct text annotations under axes_1 use font-size 6px; the title says Numbers mark rows with several cases; most rows hold one.

figures.caption_limits: Columns represent environment-specific tuples and are not comparable across environments. Eleven unscored matrix rows are distinct from the ten rows belonging to entirely unscored environments.

aggregation.exact_title: Recorded failure labels, all environments combined
aggregation.exact_footer: Global counts across all 128 FAIL outcomes; the per-environment breakdown is in the article text.

figures.caption_limits: The SVG contains global failure counts, with no environment split. The final article must supply its environment breakdown separately. Runtime aggregation is an analysis convention.

recommended_candidate.resolution: All four paths were resolved from the existing posts directory to the inspected original SVG files.
recommended_candidate.preservation: A new filename in posts preserves the current internal article and original SVG files.

limits: No visual rendering, browser inspection or publication check was performed.
SVG source inspection confirms labels and encoded shapes, not final page layout or readability.
Two Wilson endpoint spot checks passed; all 36 interval values were not independently recomputed.
